# PRSPARES — Wholesale Mobile Phone Repair Parts (Factory-Direct, Shenzhen)

> PRSPARES (phonerepairspares.com) is a Shenzhen/Huaqiangbei factory-direct **B2B wholesale** supplier of mobile phone repair parts for independent repair shops, parts distributors, refurbishers, and online resellers worldwide. Core products: LCD/OLED screen assemblies (Original / OEM / aftermarket grades), replacement batteries, cameras, charging ports, flex cables, IC chips, and repair tools — covering iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Huawei, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, and Google Pixel. Differentiators: factory-direct pricing (no middleman), 10+ years in repair parts, strict incoming-material QC, 12-month warranty, transparent tiered pricing (10+ / 50+ / 200+ units), and detailed English sourcing guides. Primary markets: USA, UK, Europe (expanding Canada, Australia, Mexico). Retail/single-unit sales are not offered — buyers submit a wholesale inquiry (RFQ).

## Key Pages
- [Wholesale Inquiry / RFQ](https://www.phonerepairspares.com/wholesale-inquiry): Request factory-direct wholesale pricing — the primary way B2B buyers engage PRSPARES.
- [About PRSPARES](https://www.phonerepairspares.com/about): Shenzhen factory-direct supplier, 10+ years in mobile phone repair parts, QC and 12-month warranty.
- [Contact](https://www.phonerepairspares.com/contact): Reach the wholesale team for sourcing and bulk orders.
